notes.title: An Apology Statement Regarding the English Version
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992215/161434359b809497e62e1355993dc2813a365960.png[/img]We indicated on the page that the English version is supported, but in the trial version, we failed to upload the English support, causing inconvenience to all players. We wholeheartedly apologize for this.
We will add support for the English version in the next update.
Once again, we offer our sincere apology.
